name: A finding of the #482 sample review turns into an eval case
description: PR #482 -> Agent runs -> the first FindingCard's 'Turn into eval case' (enabled because the seed accepts the review's findings) -> the control flips to 'Eval case created'. WRITES a case to the database, so it runs last and needs the fresh stack of the hermetic runner: on a re-run the created state shows before any click. Flow 15 must stay ordered before it, since this adds a third case to the agent.
